candidates.reasoning: The endpoint appears to generate a new reset token after a 'verified' request but does not validate any prior token or proof that the user actually owns the reset request. This could allow an attacker to trigger token issuance without proper verification.

candidates.title: Potential overexposure of user SSN in profile endpoint
evidence: row = conn.execute("SELECT id,username,email,ssn FROM users WHERE id=%s", (profile_id,)).fetchone()
candidates.reasoning: The endpoint returns the SSN field of any user profile to any authenticated principal, without checking that the requester is the owner or has appropriate privileges. This leaks highly sensitive personal data.
